I use it to create draft prefill with the good knowledge + compact history of the conversation with each mail resume Any resources to support this? Are you willing to work on this? sources.title: WhatsApp Business Cloud connection stuck on “Creating a connection”
sources.text: I want to connect my WhatsApp Business Cloud account to Make using the Watch Events module so that incoming WhatsApp messages can trigger my automation.
taskExcerpts: I want to connect my WhatsApp Business Cloud account to Make using the Watch Events module so that incoming WhatsApp messages can trigger my automation.

spans.text: What is your goal? I want to connect my WhatsApp Business Cloud account to Make using the Watch Events module so that incoming WhatsApp messages can trigger my automation. What is the problem & what have you tried? The connection process gets stuck indefinitely on “Creating a connection” and never opens the Meta authorization flow. I have already tested: Microsoft Edge normal mode Microsoft Edge InPrivate mode Google Chrome normal mode Creating the connection from a scenario using WhatsApp Business Cloud → Watch Events Creating the connection directly from Credentials → New connection On the Meta side, the setup appears correct: Meta Business Portfolio “Agente Financeiro” created Meta app for WhatsApp Business created WhatsApp Business account created successfully Phone number registered and verified In Meta Business Settings → WhatsApp Accounts, the phone number appears as Connected No partner is assigned to the WhatsApp account Because the same issue happens in multiple browsers and also directly from Credentials, it seems the problem is with the Make authorization flow rather than with the scenario. Screenshots (scenario flow, module settings, errors)

sources.title: n8n Information Extractor schema documentation · product evidence
sources.text: Use the Information Extractor node to extract structured information from incoming data. On this page, you'll find the node parameters for the Information Extractor node, and links to more resources. Node parameters Text defines the input text to extract information from. This is usually an expression that references a field from the input items. For example, this could be {{ $json.chatInput }} if the input is a chat trigger, or {{ $json.text }} if a previous node is Extract from PDF. Use Schema Type to choose how you want to describe the desired output data format. You can choose between: From Attribute Descriptions : This option allows you to define the schema by specifying the list of attributes and their descriptions. Generate From JSON Example : Input an example JSON object to automatically generate the schema. The node uses the object property types and names. It ignores the actual values. n8n treats every field as mandatory when generating schemas from JSON examples. Define using JSON Schema : Manually input the JSON schema. Read the JSON Schema guides and examples for help creating a valid JSON schema.
